entities.name: Lamina V pyramidal neurons of rACC

relationships.subject: Chronic facial inflammatory pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus chronic pain processing is associated with dynamic changes in rACC activity: first enhanced and subsequently decreased, at the time of anxiety-like behavior.

relationships.subject: Chronic facial inflammatory pain
relationships.evidence_quote: both their intrinsic excitability and excitatory synaptic inputs have undergone long-term depression (LTD) at post-injection day 10

key_findings: rACC neuronal activity is biphasic after CFA (up day 3, down day 10); anxiety appears at day 10 with rACC LTD.
